zh.attSaveNote: 先保存笔记，再添加附件
zh.attReadOnly: 只读附件：可以查看、下载和复制引用。
zh.attDropHint: 将文件拖到这里，或点击“添加附件”多选上传
zh.attDropMore: 拖入文件，继续添加附件
zh.attFileTypes: 支持图片、PDF 和其他任意文件，按顺序逐个上传。
zh.attInsertHint: “插入正文”会将附件引用附加到当前正文末尾。
zh.attReconciling: 正在核对服务器已保存的附件…
zh.attUploadFailed: 上传失败，请重试此文件。
zh.attUploadFinished: 本批次已结束，收到 {count} 个成功回执；附件列表已刷新。
zh.attUploadStopped: 已停止本批次，收到 {count} 个成功回执；附件列表已刷新。中断前已提交的文件仍会保留。
zh.attUploadRefreshFailed: 本批次已结束，但核对附件失败。部分文件可能已经保存，请刷新列表确认后再重试。
zh.attBatchFailures: 以下文件的上传未确认
zh.attBatchFailureHint: 其他文件会继续上传。网络错误不一定撤销已保存的文件，请以刷新后的附件列表为准。
zh.attUrlUnavailable: 此附件缺少可用的同源地址，请刷新列表后再试。
zh.attCopied: 附件的 Markdown 引用已复制。
zh.attClipboardUnavailable: 浏览器暂不支持自动复制。
zh.attManualCopy: 自动复制未完成，已选中下方引用，可手工复制。
zh.attManualCopyLabel: 手工复制 Markdown 引用
zh.attManualCopyHint: 按 Ctrl+C / ⌘C，或使用系统复制菜单。
zh.attMissingReference: 服务器未提供有效的 Markdown 引用，请刷新列表。
zh.attInserted: 附件引用已附加到正文末尾，将随正文一起保存。
zh.attInsertRejected: 正文暂不能修改，请检查编辑器状态后重试。
zh.attInsertFailed: 插入正文失败；可以复制引用后手动粘贴。
zh.attRemoveHint: 仅将附件移出此列表，原始文件仍保留。原有正文链接和历史版本引用仍可用。
zh.attRemoved: 附件已移出列表，原有正文链接和历史版本引用仍可用。
zh.attRemovedRefreshFailed: 附件已移出列表，原有引用仍可用；列表刷新失败，请重试加载。
zh.attRemoveFailed: 移出列表的请求未确认，请核对刷新后的列表。
zh.attConflict: 此附件已发生变化，列表已刷新。请核对后再操作。
zh.attConflictRefreshFailed: 此附件已发生变化；列表刷新失败，请重新加载后再操作。
zh.attUnavailable: 附件面板已切换或关闭，请重新打开后操作。
zh.attRequestFailed: 附件请求失败，请稍后重试。
zh.attInvalidResponse: 附件服务返回了无法识别的响应（HTTP {status}），请重试。

en.attSaveNote: Save this note before adding attachments.
en.attInvalidOwner: Attachments are unavailable for this record.
en.attReadOnly: Read-only attachments: view, download, or copy references.
en.attDropHint: Drop files here, or select multiple files with “Add files”
en.attDropMore: Drop more files to add attachments
en.attFileTypes: Images, PDFs, and any other files. Files upload one at a time.
en.attInsertHint: “Insert into text” appends the attachment reference to the end of the current text.
en.attReconciling: Checking attachments saved by the server…
en.attLoadFailed: Could not load attachments. Please retry.
en.attUploadFailed: Upload failed. Please retry this file.
en.attUploadFinished: Batch finished with {count} acknowledged uploads. The attachment list has been refreshed.
en.attUploadStopped: Batch stopped with {count} acknowledged uploads. The list has been refreshed. Files committed before interruption remain saved.
en.attUploadRefreshFailed: The batch ended, but the attachment list could not be checked. Some files may already be saved. Refresh before retrying.
en.attBatchFailures: Uploads not confirmed for these files
en.attBatchFailureHint: Other files continue uploading. A network error may follow a saved upload; check the refreshed attachment list.
en.attUrlUnavailable: A usable same-origin address is missing. Refresh the attachment list and try again.
en.attClipboardUnavailable: Automatic copying is unavailable in this browser.
en.attManualCopy: Automatic copying did not finish. The reference below is selected for manual copying.
en.attManualCopyHint: Press Ctrl+C / ⌘C, or use your system’s copy menu.
en.attMissingReference: The server did not provide a valid Markdown reference. Refresh the list.
en.attInserted: Reference appended to the end of the text. It will be saved with your edits.
en.attInsertRejected: The editor cannot accept changes right now. Check its state and try again.
en.attInsertFailed: Could not insert the reference. Copy it and paste it into the text instead.
en.attRemoveHint: Only remove this attachment from the list. The original file is retained; existing text links and version history references continue to work.
en.attRemoved: Attachment removed from the list. Existing text links and version history references still work.
en.attRemovedRefreshFailed: Attachment removed from the list; existing references still work. Refresh the list again to check.
en.attRemoveFailed: Removal was not confirmed. Check the refreshed list.
en.attConflict: This attachment has changed. The list has been refreshed; review it before trying again.
en.attConflictRefreshFailed: This attachment has changed, and refreshing failed. Reload the list before trying again.
en.attUnavailable: This attachment panel was closed or switched. Reopen it to continue.
en.attRequestFailed: The attachment request failed. Please try again.
en.attInvalidResponse: The attachment service returned an unreadable response (HTTP {status}). Please retry.
